name: Tirolerhof
beschreibung:
The Tirolerhof Dölsach is a traditional inn in the heart of Dölsach in East Tyrol. Under the direction of Karolina Glanzer, it combines a dining room, guest rooms and rooms for celebrations and gatherings under one roof. Guests can expect honest, home-style cuisine in a cosy atmosphere.

For overnight stays, six timelessly furnished rooms are available: a suite, double and single rooms as well as a Montour room. Breakfast is served as a lovingly laid table with regional ingredients and rolls from Karolinas Brötchenstube – not a buffet.

The inn is centrally located and is an ideal starting point for East Tyrol: the Aguntum Roman Museum, the Lienz Dolomites, the Ederplan with the Debanttal valley and the Drau cycle path are nearby. The Tirolerhof is open seasonally, from late summer to spring.
